'''Garvedon''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the cousin of [[Ranulph Tarkin/Legends|Ranulph Tarkin]], a member of the influential [[Tarkin family/Legends|Tarkin family]]. Tarkin served as the [[Governor-General/Legends|Governor-General]] of the [[Seswenna sector/Legends|Seswenna sector]] and after he became the [[Sector/Legends|sector's]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in [[54 BBY/Legends|54 BBY]], Garvedon succeeded him as Governor-General.
